title: Screen Recording App
summary: Screen Recorder for Android - facecam, internal audio, no watermark. Samsung+
description:
Screen Recorder for Android - record your screen in one tap. Gameplay, tutorials, reactions, bug reports - captured to MP4, saved straight to your device.

A simple, reliable recorder with internal audio, facecam, and draw tools - without the trade-offs:

• No watermark
• No ads
• No subscription, no sign-up, no account
• No upload - recordings stay on your device
• Available in 22 languages

WORKS ON PHONE, TABLET, AND ANDROID TV - SAMSUNG GALAXY READY
One app that adapts to your device. Samsung Galaxy, Pixel, Xiaomi, OnePlus, and every major Android brand.
• Phone & tablet - one-tap recorder, portrait or landscape, inline preview of your clips
• Android TV - D-pad-native layout with quality / audio toggles. Save to internal storage or a USB drive.

CORE RECORDING
• Record any app or home screen as high-quality MP4
• Up to 1080p at 60 fps, bitrate up to 100 Mbps
• Record the full screen, or pick a region and capture just one part
• H.264 or H.265 / HEVC - HEVC makes smaller files on supported devices
• Internal audio - game sounds, video, music - with adjustable volume
• Microphone narration with adjustable volume - mix both at once
• Pause and resume a single recording without creating two files
• Auto-stop timer: 5 / 15 / 30 min, 1 hour, 2 hours, or unlimited
• Save to Movies folder, a custom location, or USB drive on TV

DUAL CAMERA & FACECAM OVERLAY
A draggable, round camera bubble over your recording. Use the front or back camera, or BOTH at once with dual camera (front + back picture-in-picture). Switch mid-recording, with mirror, three sizes, four positions, and zoom.

EDIT ON YOUR PHONE - NO OTHER APP NEEDED
A full editor built in, everything processed locally on your device:
• Trim, cut, mute, change speed, rotate and mirror
• Crop and zoom, compress to a smaller file
• Live filters, and export any clip as a GIF
• Import your own videos to edit and share too

ONE-TAP SHORTCUTS
Add a record or screenshot widget to your home screen, or a tile to Quick Settings - capture in one tap. Widgets are customizable: pick a colour, opacity, and label, or match your wallpaper (Material You).

PRIVACY MASKS - HIDE SENSITIVE DATA
Black out anything you don't want on camera. Drop boxes over passwords, names, or private messages and they stay hidden - set them before you start or adjust them mid-recording.

FLOATIE - ONE-TAP CONTROLS FROM ANY APP
A tiny floating bubble on top of your screen while you record. One tap to pause / stop, screenshot, mute, toggle facecam, swap camera, draw, edit privacy masks, or open the app.

DRAW ON SCREEN WHILE RECORDING
Pen and eraser, six colours, four widths, undo, clear all. Strokes are captured straight into the recording.

SCREENSHOTS
Built-in screenshots: one tap from the Quick Settings tile or widget, or long-press the Floatie mid-recording. They land in their own Screenshots tab - edit, share, or delete.

IN-APP LIBRARY
• See resolution, frame rate, bitrate, orientation, and codec at a glance
• Play inline with transport controls (scrub, ±10 s, replay)
• Rename, share to any app, delete
• Select several at once to delete in bulk or export as a single ZIP
• 30-day Recently Deleted recovery

LIGHT OR DARK
Light, dark, or follow your system theme - your choice.

PRIVACY
Local-first. Recordings stay on your device and are never uploaded. The app asks only for what it needs. No data collected for advertising; diagnostic pings contain no personal info or screen content.

PERFECT FOR
• Gamers capturing clips on Samsung Galaxy, Pixel, Android TV
• Creators making tutorials and reaction videos with facecam
• Developers filing bug reports with video context
• Teachers preparing lessons and walkthroughs

CHROMEBOOK NOTE
On ChromeOS, the app opens our free web recorder at screenrecording.app - no download, no sign-up, same privacy.

GET STARTED
Tap Start Recording, choose what to capture, and go. Everything you record stays on your device.
